    special_rows = []
    for r, row in enumerate(g):
        cells = [(c, v) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v not in (a, b)]

            special_rows.append((r, cells))

    pattern_row = max(special_rows, key=lambda x: len(x[1]))[0]
    seq = []
    last = None
    run = 0
    for v in g[pattern_row]:
        if v in (a, b):
            last = None
            run = 0
        else:
            if v == last:
                run += 1
            else:
                if last is not None:
                    seq.append(last)
                last = v
                run = 1
    if last is not None:

    markers = [(r, cells[0][1]) for r, cells in special_rows

    out = [[v if v in (a, b) else a for v in row] for row in g]
